Theme: **Disruptive Creative Reuse** (source: "Reuso Criativo Disruptivo"). Style: Innovative, Sustainable, Raw, Playful. Keywords: upcycling, creative reuse, sustainable, innovative, raw, playful, unconventional, DIY, community, eco-friendly. Era: 2026+ Circular Economy. Visual direction: inspired by the Campana Brothers — scrap, rope, and recycled-material textures in UI elements; imperfect stencil-effect typography; photographs of upcycled objects focused on transformation; hover micro-interactions where pieces "assemble"/"disassemble"; section transitions with collage/cut-out effects; lime green and vibrant orange accents. Output category: **Playful & Youth** — all user-facing copy in **English**, energetic and irreverent but clear. --- ## 1. Text-safe on light backgrounds: `#333333`, `#5A5A5A`, `#8A2BE2`, `#1F7A1F`, `#B23344`. Concrete Gray `#A9A9A9` is for borders/textures only — never body text. In dark mode, the bright accents become text-safe on charcoal. * **Radius & Shadows:** `--radius-sm: 5px`, `--radius-md: 10px`, `--radius-lg: 20px`; `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` — prefer hard-edged "cut paper" shadows (e.g., `4px 4px 0 rgba(51,51,51,0.15)`) over soft blurs to keep the raw collage feel. * **Spacing & Transitions:** `--spacing-gap`; `--transition-fast: 0.2s ease-in-out`; `--transition-normal: 0.5s ease-in-out` (per source spec); `--ease-standard: ease-in-out`; `--ease-snap: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)` for assembly "snap" effects. **Never write `transition: all`** — always list explicit properties. * **Elevation/Stacking:** `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`. * **Mandatory classes from source spec:** `.recycled-texture-bg`, `.stencil-text`, `.collage-transition` must exist and behave as defined in Section 3. ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support * Define dark tokens under **both** `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class on ``; bright accents (lime, orange, blue, yellow) are text-safe here. * **Persistence:** theme choice saved to `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme`; visible toggle control in the header with correct `aria-pressed` and dynamic `aria-label` ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode") and a Google Material Symbol icon. * **Exception clause:** The source specification requested a light-mode-first presentation — default to **Light** on first visit;
